inicio.kicker: Cinema with AI Program · course 0 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Direction: think like a director before you generate anything
inicio.lead: The generator carries out the work; you make the decisions. Shot, angle, movement, light, composition, character sheet and shot list with sound. Each lesson ends with a file that the page itself checks, with no terminal and no credits spent. At the end, you have a 30-second scene ready to turn into a prompt in any generator.
inicio.capa_alt: Dark film set seen from behind a cinema camera on a dolly track; in the background, a pencil storyboard on the wall.
inicio.aulas_sub: One scene runs through the whole course: "The first batch". Each lesson adds a layer of direction to it, and you do the same with yours.

itens: Creators, teachers and people who make videos for companies.
People who have already generated images or video with AI and found the result random.
People who don't use a terminal: everything is done in the browser and in a text file.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Decide shot, angle, movement and light based on what the audience should feel.
Write the character sheet that keeps the same character across every shot.
Deliver a 30-second storyboard with sound for each shot, checked by the page.
Take the package to any generator, without depending on one platform.
1 · Generation: image and video with AI
2 · Production: from script to finished film
3 · Motion by code with an agent
